text_en: The Israelites again did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , and the Lord gave them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.
text_cn: 以色列子民又行了上主视为恶的事，因此上主把他们交于培肋舍特人手中四十年之久。

text_en: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the tribe of the Danites, whose name was Manoah. His wife was barren, having borne no children.
text_cn: 那时，在祚辣有一个人，属于丹支派，名叫玛诺亚，他的妻子是个石女，从未生育。

text_en: And the angel of the Lord appeared to the woman and said to her, “Although you are barren, having borne no children, you shall conceive and bear a son.
text_cn: 上主的使者显现给那妇人，对她说：“看，你原是个石女，从未生育，但是你要怀孕生子。

text_en: Now be careful not to drink wine or strong drink, or to eat anything unclean,
text_cn: 今后要留心：清酒浓酒都不可喝，各种不洁的东西也不可吃！

text_en: for you shall conceive and bear a son. No razor is to come on his head, for the boy shall be a nazirite to God from birth. It is he who shall begin to deliver Israel from the hand of the Philistines. ”
text_cn: 看，你将怀孕生子，剃刀不可触及他的头，因为这孩子从母胎就是献于天主的；他要开始从培肋舍特人手中拯救以色列。”

text_en: Then the woman came and told her husband, “A man of God came to me, and his appearance was like that of an angel of God, most awe-inspiring; I did not ask him where he came from, and he did not tell me his name;
text_cn: 那妇人遂去告诉自己的丈夫说：“有一个天主的人来到我这里，他的容貌好像天主的使者，极其威严；我没有问他从哪里来，他也没有告诉我他的名字。

text_en: but he said to me, ‘You shall conceive and bear a son. So then drink no wine or strong drink, and eat nothing unclean, for the boy shall be a nazirite to God from birth to the day of his death. ’”
text_cn: 他对我说：看，你将怀孕生子，从今以后清酒浓酒都不可喝，各种不洁的东西都不可吃，因为这孩子从母胎一直到死，是献于天主的。”

text_en: Then Manoah entreated the Lord , and said, “O Lord , I pray, let the man of God whom you sent come to us again and teach us what we are to do concerning the boy who will be born. ”
text_cn: 玛诺亚就向上主恳求说：“我主！求你叫你所派的那位天主的人再到我们这里来！指教我们对于将生的婴孩应该作什么？”

text_en: God listened to Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field; but her husband Manoah was not with her.
text_cn: 天主听了玛诺亚的话；天主的使者又来到那妇人跟前；那时她正坐在田间，她的丈夫没有同她在一起。

text_en: So the woman ran quickly and told her husband, “The man who came to me the other day has appeared to me. ”
text_cn: 那妇人就急速跑去告诉丈夫说：“看，那天来我跟前的那个人，又显现给我了。”

text_en: Manoah got up and followed his wife, and came to the man and said to him, “Are you the man who spoke to this woman? ” And he said, “I am. ”
text_cn: 玛诺亚就起来，跟着妻子来到那人跟前，对他说：“你就是向这妇人说话的那人吗？”他回答说：“我就是。”

text_en: Then Manoah said, “Now when your words come true, what is to be the boy’s rule of life; what is he to do? ”
text_cn: 玛诺亚向他说：“当你的话应验的时候，我们应该怎样管教这孩子？要怎样待他？”

text_en: The angel of the Lord said to Manoah, “Let the woman give heed to all that I said to her.
text_cn: 上主的使者对玛诺亚说：“我给这妇人所说的一切，她都当留神：

text_en: She may not eat of anything that comes from the vine. She is not to drink wine or strong drink, or eat any unclean thing. She is to observe everything that I commanded her. ”
text_cn: 凡葡萄树所结的，她不能吃；清酒浓酒她不能喝，各种不洁的东西她不能吃；凡我所吩咐她的，她都该遵守。”

text_en: Manoah said to the angel of the Lord , “Allow us to detain you, and prepare a kid for you. ”
text_cn: 玛诺亚对上主的使者说：“请容许我款留你，为你预备一只小山羊。”

text_en: The angel of the Lord said to Manoah, “If you detain me, I will not eat your food; but if you want to prepare a burnt offering, then offer it to the Lord . ” (For Manoah did not know that he was the angel of the Lord . )
text_cn: 上主的使者对玛诺亚说：“你虽然款留我，我却不吃你的食物；假使你要献一全燔祭，就当献于上主。”因玛诺亚当时还不知道他是上主的使者。

text_en: Then Manoah said to the angel of the Lord , “What is your name, so that we may honor you when your words come true? ”
text_cn: 玛诺亚问上主的使者说：“你叫什么名字？当你的话应验的时候，我们好恭敬你。”

text_en: But the angel of the Lord said to him, “Why do you ask my name? It is too wonderful. ”
text_cn: 上主的使者回答说：“你为什么问我的名字？它是奥妙的。”

text_en: So Manoah took the kid with the grain offering, and offered it on the rock to the Lord , to him who works wonders.
text_cn: 玛诺亚取了一只小山羊和素祭，在一块磐石上献于行奇事的上主。

text_en: When the flame went up toward heaven from the altar, the angel of the Lord ascended in the flame of the altar while Manoah and his wife looked on; and they fell on their faces to the ground.
text_cn: 当火焰从祭坛上向天升起时，上主的使者也在祭坛上的火焰中上升了。玛诺亚和他的妻子看见这事，就俯伏在地。

text_en: The angel of the Lord did not appear again to Manoah and his wife. Then Manoah realized that it was the angel of the Lord .
text_cn: 上主的使者没有再显现给玛诺亚和他的妻子，那时玛诺亚才知道他是上主的使者。

text_en: And Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, for we have seen God. ”
text_cn: 玛诺亚对自己的妻子说：“我们必定要死，因为我们看见了天主。”

text_en: But his wife said to him, “If the Lord had meant to kill us, he would not have accepted a burnt offering and a grain offering at our hands, or shown us all these things, or now announced to us such things as these. ”
text_cn: 但他妻子对他说：“如果上主有意叫我们死，必定不会悦纳我们的手所献的全燔祭和素祭，必不会使我们看见这些事，也不会使我们听到像现在这样的话。”

text_en: The woman bore a son, and named him Samson. The boy grew, and the Lord blessed him.
text_cn: 后来那妇人生了一个儿子，给他起名叫三松；孩子渐渐长大，上主降福了他。

text_en: The spirit of the Lord began to stir him in Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
text_cn: 在玛哈乃丹，即在祚辣与厄市陶耳之间，上主的神开始感动他。
